# Pirulen H1 preview

R0 typography update. Copied the user-supplied Pirulen Regular WOFF2 byte-for-byte to `web/app/fonts/pirulen-regular.woff2` and loaded it locally at its actual 400 weight. Applied it only to H1 elements; Basetica remains on card titles, controls and body text. H1 sizing, line height and tracking accommodate the wider letterforms. The collection title sizes relative to its container, preserving its complete text and existing scramble effect.

The first visual pass found four page headings taking three lines at 320px. Under the user's permission to shorten titles, changed them to "About LABx", "The draw", "Your data" and "Your bench". The first three now fit one line at 320px; the profile heading takes two. Raffle names are unchanged.

Font SHA-256: `138b0127fbb703d452943e3df0530e51eaf723693d81f1e674944e4fec91681a`.

Final verification: 124 web tests pass. Production build exits 0, including type validation, with the existing dependency warning. Browser checks pass for 14 routes at 320, 390, 768 and 1440px, 56 combinations, including all four raffle details and the not-found page. Chrome's rendered-font inspection confirms Pirulen on H1s and Basetica on navigation. No clipped headings, horizontal overflow or page errors. Scramble resolves on hover and the reduced-motion title remains visible. Final screenshots wait for fonts, images and entry animations. Desktop home, mobile detail and shortened About heading inspected. Evidence: `artifacts/pirulen-headings/`.

Local Preview is open on the home page. No push or deployment. No runtime dependencies, purchase behavior or contract changes. Model usage is unavailable; no delegated workers required for this R0 change.
